title: The push-forward formula (3.6) defines a current in V (parent Step 3)
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P and V ⊆ ℝ^Q be open, T ∈ D_n(U) with T = τ(M,θ,ξ) for a triple with IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ, f continuous on U with f⁻¹(K) ∩ spt T compact for every compact K ⊆ V, and L : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^Q) Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable with sup_{x∈M∩K} ‖L(x)‖ < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U. Then there is S ∈ D_n(V) with S(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·(L(x)_#ξ(x))(ω(f(x))) dHⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(V).
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (V : Set (Eucl Q)), IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → ContinuousOn f U → (∀ K, IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → IsCompact (f ⁻¹' K ∩ T.support)) → AEStronglyMeasurable L ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ M ∩ K, ‖L x‖ ≤ C) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn V n, ∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, S ω = ∫ x in M, θ x * nVectorPushforward n (L x) (ξ x) ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) n) (f x)) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))
